text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1074, Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

The Oiled Bronze Sea Scallop Door Knocker by Michael Healy Designs features a stunning attention to detail that really brings it to life. The Oiled Bronze Sea Scallop Premium Knocker is large enough to hold its own even on the biggest of doors. The seashell door knocker is a great finishing touch to any beach house. The Oiled Bronze finish is rich and luxurious.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass with Brown Patina Nickel Silver

Also Available: smaller 4" Oiled Bronze Bay Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Oiled Bronze Sea Scallop Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 5-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
